Paragraph: And when you have thus learned the truth, you will know that all living beings are but part of Me—and that they are in Me, and are Mine.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Illusion of separation, prejudice, and emotional distress caused by seeing individuals as disconnected entities.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna states: 'And when you have thus learned the truth, you will know that all living beings are but part of Me—and that they are in Me, and are Mine.'
Outcome/Resolution: Attaining true knowledge dispels delusion, revealing the shared spiritual unity of all living entities in the Supreme.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Universal Unity: Recognizing the common essence connecting all living beings
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Dispelling Delusion: Overcoming false cognitive biases that create division and hostility
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Empathy and Oneness: Developing deep compassion by perceiving oneself in relation to others

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Yaj jnatva na punar moham (Having known which, you will never fall back into illusion)
Yenasrutani bhutany aseseni datsmanym atho mayi (Seeing all living beings within the Self and within Krishna)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: True knowledge permanently eliminates illusion, revealing that all souls exist as integral parts of the Supreme.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Recognizing fundamental human unity eliminates feelings of isolation, prejudice, and existential anxiety.
